hook: Your graphic is done. The resizing isn't.

facebook.text:
Your graphic is done. The resizing isn't.

Square for the feed, story for the top of the app, wide for the link preview. One finished idea turns into three rounds of layout work, and ten minutes a graphic quietly becomes hours a month.

Poaster takes that chore off your plate. Paste a link or type a few words, and it builds the square, story, and wide versions together, in your brand, ready for their placements. The message stays consistent across sizes instead of getting rebuilt each time.

Swipe through for the short version. Try it free at poaster.co, no account needed for the first 3 downloads.
